crossRefs.note: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

Give us day by day our daily bread.

translations.web: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
translations.bsb: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.
translations.kjv: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
translations.asv: Wherefore we faint not; but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
